generations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: character model sheet for a 2D animated screensaver, visual direction review only, not a final runtime sprite sheet. Input images 1 and 2 are the original Johnny Castaway pixel sprites, used as identity, costume, silhouette and pose references. Create a polished modern 2D cartoon interpretation of THIS same castaway. Preserve his recognizable white sailor cap, prominent long rounded nose, dark facial hair/stubble, red upper-body color area, white shorts and long thin limbs with large bare feet as shown in the references. Keep his lanky, slightly stooped, scruffy comic personality and adult appearance. Use clean confident dark outlines, warm flat colors and very restrained two-tone cel shading. He should feel hand-drawn and expressive, readable at small screen size. Do not add new accessories, props, logos or change his outfit. The sheet has four clearly separated full-body drawings of the SAME design on an off-white background: standing side profile matching input 1, stepping side profile matching input 2, standing opposite profile, and a relaxed three-quarter view. Keep the body proportions consistent across all four drawings; avoid extreme squash/stretch. Give each drawing room so no limbs or hats overlap. No text, no titles, no texture over the character, no pixel-art effect, no 3D rendering. The purpose is to choose a faithful, animation-friendly cartoon Johnny before authoring individual animation frames.

generations.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / style-transfer. Asset type: second character model-sheet concept for Johnny Castaway. Image 1 is the first concept sheet to revise. Images 2 and 3 are the original Johnny Castaway sprites and are authoritative for character identity and proportions. The user likes the clean 2D cartoon drawing style and specifically LOVES the ragged white shorts in image 1, but says the character himself feels off. Keep the same drawing style, line quality, restrained cel shading, white ragged shorts and sheet format. Redesign Johnny to match the original sprites much more closely: leaner scragglier silhouette, narrow sloping shoulders, thin neck and limbs, a more awkward slightly stooped stance. Reduce the bulky rounded torso from image 1. Make the head less conventionally handsome and less generic: closely follow the original large projecting nose, small scruffy chin and sparse beard, and tiny expressive eyes. Replace the confident half-lidded smirk with an earnest, slightly bewildered castaway expression. Make the white sailor cap modest and flatter like the original, not the giant swept-up hat of image 1. Reduce the mop of black hair and the dense full beard; retain just the scruffy hair and stubble suggested in the originals. Keep the sunburnt bare chest, bare feet and original costume. Preserve adult Johnny's recognizable identity, not a new character. Four separated full-body poses: side standing, side stepping, opposite side standing, front/three-quarter standing. All four must use precisely the same revised proportions. Plain off-white background, no text, no props, no additional accessories. This is a faithful cartoon modernization of the original castaway rather than a generic sailor.
